title: Optics
content: The study of nature and propagation of light is known as optics.
e: The study of nature and propagation of light is known as optics. Optics is the study of the nature and travel of light.

title: Reflection of light
content: When light is incident on the surface of an object some of the light is sent back and this phenomenon is called reflection of light.
e: When light is incident on the surface of an object some of the light is sent back and this phenomenon is called reflection of light. Reflection of light is light bouncing back from a surface. On reflection, the angle of incidence equals the angle of reflection.

title: Concave mirror
content: If the reflecting surface of a mirror forms part of the inner surface of a hollow sphere, the mirror is called a concave mirror.
e: If the reflecting surface of a mirror forms part of the inner surface of a hollow sphere, the mirror is called a concave mirror. A concave mirror can converge light to a real focus.

title: Convex mirror
content: If the reflecting surface of a mirror forms part of the outer surface of a hollow sphere, the mirror is called a convex mirror.
e: If the reflecting surface of a mirror forms part of the outer surface of a hollow sphere, the mirror is called a convex mirror. A convex mirror diverges light and gives a wide field of view.
